resourceProfile.assessment: The complete effective es-419 locale, canonical English scope, glossary, review metadata, and UI context were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata validation, TypeScript typecheck, the full test suite, and the production build passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh independent pass identified 17 grouped areas for improvement; all 17 were corrected in the bounded es-419 batch.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed; the locale remains machine-reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner authorized correction and commit, but not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: The locale mixes tú, usted, and infinitive-style UI wording.
findings.resolution: Standardized the effective es-419 UI on informal tú forms for these user-facing actions.
evidence: The same user-facing surface uses Elige, Ingresa, Mantente, and Explora alongside Calcule, Consulte, Elija, and Seleccione.
Material and battery comparison selectors also mix Elige, Seleccionar, and Seleccione.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should es-419 standardize on informal tú or formal usted before the next correction batch?

findings.summary: Several shared labels remain literal or grammatically incomplete.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the shared labels as natural Spanish UI phrases.
evidence: Navegación con calculadora is not a natural label for calculator navigation.
Cambiar al modo de luz is a literal rendering of light mode.
Basado en preestablecido is missing the article and uses an awkward noun.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should these shared UI labels be corrected in the next bounded batch?

findings.summary: Coil, wire, and winding terminology is not consistently aligned with the locale glossary or the calculator context.
findings.resolution: Standardized vaping-facing coil terminology on resistencia and wire terminology on alambre.
evidence: The glossary prefers resistencia for vaping-facing coil usage, while many calculator labels still use bobina.
The same technical surface alternates between alambre and cable.
Espaciado de envoltura and cable paralelo sin torcer are literal and obscure descriptions of turns and wire construction.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the next batch standardize coil-facing UI on resistencia and wire terminology on alambre, with bobina retained only where geometry requires it?

findings.summary: Battery-calculator labels blur output power, discharge current, and runtime semantics.
findings.resolution: Clarified battery output power, discharge-current limits, and continuous autonomy labels and notices.
evidence: Salida del atomizador does not explicitly identify output power.
Tiempo de ejecución estimado and Tiempo de ejecución continuo sound like software execution rather than battery operating time.
El consumo estimado está dentro del límite efectivo de la batería does not clearly identify discharge current.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the battery calculator use explicit terms such as potencia de salida, corriente de descarga, and autonomía?

findings.summary: Battery help and evidence text still contains wording that can obscure the measured quantity or evidence qualification.
findings.resolution: Rewrote safety-sensitive battery help and evidence strings to identify current values and evidence limitations explicitly.
evidence: The continuous-discharge label is presented as a clasificación rather than clearly as a current of __ A.
Paquete interno en el dispositivo is awkward and does not clearly contrast an integrated pack with a user-replaceable cell.
El fabricante de la celda subyacente no se asume en el envoltorio is not idiomatic Spanish and weakens the evidence limitation.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should this battery-safety group be rewritten and reviewed as a single safety-critical terminology batch?

findings.summary: Battery lifecycle and chemistry notices contain mistranslated or unnatural concepts.
findings.resolution: Corrected lifecycle, supersession, and chemistry wording.
evidence: Probablemente sea reemplazado changes a possible supersession into a prediction about the battery.
Si ha sido superada is not a natural rendering of whether a model has been superseded.
Etiqueta química is not the intended meaning of a confirmed battery chemistry.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should these notices be rewritten around reemplazada/sustituida and composición química?

findings.summary: TCR is repeatedly shortened to an ambiguous temperature coefficient.
findings.resolution: Standardized TCR on coeficiente de temperatura de la resistencia across UI and catalog content.
evidence: Coeficiente de temperatura omits that the coefficient applies to electrical resistance.
The catalog bullet translates α as a generic material temperature coefficient rather than a resistance temperature coefficient.
The title and property label should use one precise term across calculator and encyclopedia surfaces.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should es-419 standardize TCR on coeficiente de temperatura de la resistencia?

findings.summary: Several formulas still expose English words or mixed decimal conventions inside Spanish technical content.
findings.resolution: Translated visible formula annotations and normalized Spanish decimal formatting in the affected examples.
evidence: The Kirchhoff voltage formula still contains (parallel branches) and (series).
The trigonometry formulas still contain opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse, and radians.
Spanish explanatory sections mix decimal dots and decimal commas, such as 4.2 V beside 4,2 V.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should all visible formula annotations and numeric examples be normalized in a dedicated technical-formatting batch?

findings.summary: Trigonometry headings and examples retain lower-case or missing-accent Spanish.
findings.resolution: Corrected trigonometry headings, accents, casing, and heading punctuation.
evidence: triangulos rectángulos is missing the initial capital and accent on Triángulos.
encontrar un lado is lower-case in a title where surrounding headings use title-style capitalization.
Formas de onda e identidades útiles. contains an unnecessary sentence period in the heading.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the trigonometry headings be normalized as part of the formula-localization batch?

findings.summary: Heat-flux prose mixes sentence capitalization and infinitive instructions.
findings.resolution: Cleaned heat-flux prose, instruction style, and numeric formatting.
evidence: The paragraph contains σ; Las temperaturas after a semicolon.
Distinguir el flujo de calor promedio is an infinitive fragment among imperative instructions.
The worked example also mixes decimal dots and commas in a way that can be misread.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the heat-flux concept receive a focused prose and number-format cleanup?

findings.summary: Mod and control-board terminology is improved but still mixes mod, tarjeta, placa, and tablero across the effective locale.
findings.resolution: Applied mod and tarjeta de control terminology consistently to the affected catalog UI.
evidence: The user-facing category uses tarjetas while the draft catalog still contains placa, tablero, and tarjeta/controlador variants.
Some strings say mod, some say modificaciones, and some say dispositivos for the same catalog category.
The glossary prefers tarjeta de control, but the policy is not applied uniformly to all labels and descriptions.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should es-419 adopt tarjeta de control for boards and preserve mod as the device term throughout the catalog UI?

findings.summary: Comparison selectors use inconsistent grammatical forms and address.
findings.resolution: Standardized battery and material comparison selectors on informal imperative wording and A/B labels.
evidence: Elige una batería is informal while the comparison description and selector labels use formal usted.
Seleccionar material A is an infinitive while Seleccione el material B is an imperative.
The battery and material comparers should expose the same A/B selector pattern.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should all es-419 comparer selectors use one formal or informal imperative pattern?

findings.summary: Several comparison messages remain awkward, especially around agreement and catalog phrasing.
findings.resolution: Rewrote comparison messages for agreement, catalog phrasing, and natural Spanish UI tone.
evidence: El mod o la tarjeta de control al que hace referencia has a mixed-gender agreement problem.
Seleccionaste conflicts with the surrounding formal comparison messages.
Perfil de control de temperatura de catálogo is understandable but unnatural, and no se registra ninguna nota is stiff UI language.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should these comparer messages be rewritten together after the register and board-terminology policy is chosen?

findings.summary: Research-record metadata remains literal, legalistic, or inconsistent in capitalization.
findings.resolution: Rewrote research-record metadata as consistent Spanish labels and messages.
evidence: Registro de material respaldado por la fuente and Registro de entidad respaldado por fuente are awkward compounds.
Confianza is less precise than nivel de confianza for evidence metadata.
nota de catálogo is lower-case while neighboring metadata labels are title-cased.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should catalog research metadata be rewritten as a consistent Spanish UI terminology group?

findings.summary: Many standalone labels remain lower-case or use inconsistent capitalization.
findings.resolution: Normalized capitalization for the affected standalone calculator labels.
evidence: voltaje de salida, tensión nominal, unidades imperiales, alambre redondo, quitar el cable, and editor TFR appear as standalone labels with inconsistent casing.
The inconsistency makes the locale look machine-generated even where the underlying terms are understandable.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should standalone Spanish labels be normalized for capitalization after the terminology corrections?

findings.summary: The e-liquid calculator mixes informal address, lower-case fragments, and literal recipe wording.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the affected juice-calculator labels and notices in the selected informal UI register.
evidence: Cantidad que quieres hacer and lo indicado en la etiqueta mix informal and fragmentary label styles.
Un valor negativo significa que la combinación actual no es viable is understandable but less direct than a result-state warning.
The surrounding calculator uses both Ingresa/Usa and formal imperative forms.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the juice calculator be normalized to the same address and label style as the rest of es-419?

findings.summary: Wire Wizard still contains literal construction labels and lower-case fragments.
findings.resolution: Clarified Wire Wizard construction terminology and normalized standalone label wording.
evidence: Diseño de alambre and Alambre trenzado are understandable but need a deliberate wire-construction terminology policy.
Retorcido is less precise than trenzado for the construction option.
control de temperatura, factor de resistencia, and quitar el cable are lower-case fragments used as standalone UI labels.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should Wire Wizard receive a dedicated terminology and capitalization pass after the coil/wire policy is selected?
